Bx.bar_b_note: A warm, appealing elder in the key art's green/brown palette with a readable face, but shown only on a black void with no light, sky or grade, so nothing here carries Valheim-class atmosphere.

Aj.bar_b_note: A near-black purple owl on a dark grey stage loses its value separation and face at small size, and the faint-end pile reads as a heap of feathers rather than a fallen creature.

Ul.bar_b_note: A convincing naturalistic boar with real fur, but it stands only about the trainer's height and the neutral stage gives no light or atmosphere to put it beside Palworld.

Jp.bar_b_note: The ram reads big and on-style in standing and hit react, but B's faint frames twist the body over and lift it off its shadow, and the stage has no atmosphere.

Ja.bar_b_note: A vivid, readable water creature in clean cyan and white, let down by B's floating faint mid and a pale grey faint end, by the tail running through the trainer, and by a stage with no atmosphere.

Me.bar_b_note: These frames look identical to Aj (same dark owl), with the same weak value separation and the same faint-end feather heap.

Es.bar_b_note: The bird renders as a near-white, chrome-edged silhouette that glows against the stage instead of the slate and tan feathering of the style bar, and its faint mid hovers.

Tw.bar_b_note: The Meadows grass, path and painted mountain sky are pleasant, but the isolated, flat-infilled wall and the low-poly, flat-shaded grey boulder sit under a flat midday grade with no haze or shafts, below Palworld's base-building finish.

Rp.bar_b_note: The wolf matches the owner's in-game Tanglevolt in standing, but the faint mid rolls it belly-up with the body lifted above its shadow, its rear overlaps the trainer, and the stage has no atmosphere.

top_changes.change: Ground every faint pose: put the hips, flank and head in contact with the floor so the body meets its own shadow (Es faint mid, Rp faint mid, Jp B and Ja B faint frames), and stop the body twisting over in Jp B.

Rework creature materials toward the style bar: give Galecrest (Es) slate-blue and tan feathering with no bright chrome edge, and lift the dark owl (Aj/Me) with a cooler rim and a readable face and eyes so it separates from the ground.

Give the homestead wall depth and a lived-in material: a thick wattle, plaster or plank infill with texture and shading instead of a flat pale fill, a deeper post-and-cap profile, and a stone footing set into the ground, used in runs with neighbouring pieces.
